name: openaccent
description: Talk to AI like someone from home: a community dialect dictionary and a personal memory of how you speak.
long_description: OpenAccent helps Claude speak your dialect without mixing dialects, drifting, or inventing words. It combines a community-built dictionary (organized by country, drawn from open sources and being reviewed by native speakers; most words are still drafts) with a personal memory of your own words and corrections, which stays on your computer. It also gives dialect cards for writing stories, songs, scripts and game dialogue, and exports a short prompt for any AI.
